    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    if not eligible_to_regenerate(target): return
    repairable = classify_injury_parts(target)
    per_tick = compute_regeneration_amount(ability,delta_time)
    restore_health_and_allowed_body_parts(target,repairable,per_tick)
    stop_when_defeated_or_regeneration_is_suppressed()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
